rawRetro.summary: Implemented the Customer Memo system end to end: one migration for the customerMemos table, an idempotent 3-record seed, a customer-memo service and authenticated CRUD + partial-name search routes, i18n strings, and a list page with URL-backed search plus create/detail/edit child-route overlays and a shared confirm-before-delete dialog. Added migration/seed, route and component tests. Verification scoped to changed files: prettier, eslint, client/server/node tsc, the new tests, and the full vitest suite (47 files / 371 tests) all pass; db:apply applied the migration and seed and a second run skipped both.

blockers.title: Documented delete-dialog focus return uses an AlertDialog prop the template does not have
blockers.symptom: The synchronized app-development Skill (frontend/references/overlay.md and table.md) documents a ProjectDeleteDialog that returns focus with <AlertDialogContent finalFocus={...} deletedFocusRef={...}>. The template's alert-dialog is built on @base-ui/react/alert-dialog 1.8.0, whose Popup.Props expose neither finalFocus nor initialFocus, so following the documented example does not type-check.
blockers.rootCause: The Skill example targets a Radix-style AlertDialog that accepts finalFocus; this application template's shadcn/ui primitives are generated on base-ui, which has no equivalent prop.
blockers.resolution: Dropped deletedFocusRef/finalFocus. After a successful delete from the list, the row (and the menu that opened the dialog) disappears, so the list sets focusSearchAfterReloadRef and focuses the search input in the existing effect that runs when loading turns false, reusing the same pattern already used for deletes from the detail drawer. Verified by the component test that deletes a row and asserts the refreshed list no longer shows it, plus a create/edit/search test.

improvements.title: Skill delete-dialog example assumes a finalFocus prop base-ui does not offer
improvements.detail: overlay.md (ProjectDeleteDialog) and table.md instruct passing finalFocus and deletedFocusRef to AlertDialogContent to move focus after a delete. The template's base-ui AlertDialog has no such prop, so an agent that copies the example gets a type error and must invent a workaround.
improvements.suggestedChange: Update the overlay.md/table.md delete-dialog example to the after-reload focus pattern that the templates already support (set a focusSearchAfterReloadRef flag before reloading and focus the search box once loading is false), or show the base-ui-idiomatic focus API if one exists. Keep the two focus paths (list delete vs. detail-drawer delete) described consistently.

improvements.title: Destructuring seed/migration context methods trips unbound-method lint
improvements.detail: SeedContext.repository is typed as a method signature, so `async run({ repository })` then calling the destructured function triggers @typescript-eslint/unbound-method under this template's eslint config (max-warnings 0). The same class-method binding surfaces in tests as `connection.repository` needing an arrow wrapper, otherwise `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'createRepository')` is thrown from the knex connection. Both are non-obvious for a first-time author.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add a short note to the migrations/seeds guidance showing `async run(context) { const repo = context.repository(...) }` (or annotating the parameter method as `this: void`), and mention that a test-built connection must bind `repository` before use.

improvements.title: DataTable needed a row-selection opt-out and the pagination footer needed a width fix
improvements.detail: A list without row selection still rendered the '0 of N row(s) selected' footer because only DataTablePagination exposed showSelectedCount; passing it through DataTable required a change to shared client/components/data-table.tsx. DataTablePagination also used a fixed w-[100px] 'Rows per page' trigger that clipped the wider zh-CN label, changed to min-w-[100px] whitespace-nowrap. Both edits are app-owned template scaffolding and will need reconciling on the next template upgrade.
improvements.suggestedChange: Upstream showSelectedCount passthrough on DataTable (and default it to false when no select column is present) and the min-w/nowrap pagination width to the template so applications do not each patch these files.

improvements.detail: A list without row selection still rendered the '0 of N row(s) selected' footer because only DataTablePagination exposed showSelectedCount; passing it through DataTable required a change to shared client/components/data-table.tsx. DataTablePagination also used a fixed w-[100px] 'Rows per page' trigger that clipped the wider zh-CN label, changed to min-w-[100px] whitespace-nowrap. Both edits are app-owned template scaffolding and will need reconciling on the next template upgrade.
